description: This file implements the UpdatePlaybackGroup class, which manages updating the playback group in a media streaming context. It processes GStreamer caps to identify audio streams and updates the playback context accordingly.

classes.name: UpdatePlaybackGroup
classes.description: A class responsible for updating the playback group based on the caps of a media stream, particularly focusing on audio streams and decode bins.

methods.name: UpdatePlaybackGroup
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UpdatePlaybackGroup with context, wrappers, and GStreamer elements.

methods.name: ~UpdatePlaybackGroup
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the update process.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the update logic, analyzing caps to identify audio streams and updating the playback context accordingly.
